scope: Bounded ten-frame real-solvated-trajectory scalability and execution smoke test; no source coordinates are distributed.

input_lineage.dataset_description: Retained private solvated protein-nucleic-acid control state

resource_observation.wall_time_status: environment-specific observation, not a benchmark guarantee
resource_observation.spatial_contract: Cell-list neighbor filtering avoided construction of a solute-endpoint-by-water Cartesian matrix.

required_caveats: This was a bounded strided subset of one trajectory, not a convergence or sampling validation.
No independent water-bridge implementation was compared against this real trajectory subset.
Residence, water exchange, and cutoff sensitivity were technically exercised, but were not interpreted scientifically from this bounded subset.
A completed run does not validate protonation, water kinetics, energetic importance, affinity, mechanism, or a biological conclusion.
